summary: Audit and safely compact SQLite FTS and WAL storage
description: Explain the multi-gigabyte state.db footprint by measuring base tables, FTS shadow tables, freelist, WAL and bytes per message, then provide a maintenance-window compaction workflow with space and downtime guards.
acceptance: R1 report attributes bytes by table/index/WAL/freelist; R2 optimize checkpoint and vacuum are separately benchmarked; R3 compaction refuses insufficient free space or a live writer unless explicitly maintenance-gated; R4 before/after size search latency and integrity evidence are emitted; R5 rollback and backup instructions are verified.
verification: scripts/run_tests.sh tests/hermes_cli -q && timeout 60 hermes sessions stats && git diff --check
